name: aster-appearance
description: 17 editor palettes after the most used themes and 5 bundled programming fonts with coding ligatures. A focused appearance studio for Antigravity.

asterAppearance.fontStyle.description: Editor font style. Italic is applied to code through one owned TextMate rule and the semantic wildcard.

asterAppearance.theme.description: Aster palette applied over the matching Visual Studio theme. Change it in Aster Atelier: Темы и шрифты.

asterAppearance.brightness.description: Colourfulness of Aster code colours in percent (-30 to 30). Change it in Aster Atelier: Темы и шрифты.

asterAppearance.contrast.description: Lightness distance of Aster code colours from the editor background in percent (-20 to 30). Text never drops below 4.5:1.

asterAppearance.uiFont.description: Use the editor font for the whole Antigravity interface (menus, panels, tabs). Off restores the IDE's own font.
